body:
Clang coverage failed the real-engine replay acceleration test when accelerated playback took1117ms against a fixed800ms deadline. Decode/draw/event work contributes to that elapsed time, so the threshold measures machine and instrumentation throughput as well as pacing. Compare each accelerated mode against normal playback of the same25-tick replay on the same build and renderer, retaining the normal800ms timing floor, live-engine speed comparison, pause/hard-pause bounds and all seven simulation/replay checksum checks. Print mode timings and include both measurements in failures.

Test-only change; no production pacing, simulation, compatibility or game-feel changes. Final native GameSpeed suite3cases229assertions passes. Controlled7ms clock-sampling overhead reproduces the old974ms failure; final replay normal1039ms versus accelerated959/950ms passes all pause/checksum checks. Public evidence is linked in the verification comment; full Clang coverage and other platforms remain for hosted master confirmation.
